verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a single free business account that holds and receives cash in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD. It stores balances in multiple currencies, offers real-time FX conversion between them, and lets you review balances through its tooling, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the multi-currency account, and support for holding balances beyond four currencies (40+ currencies are cited for payouts only).
